🚀 Join DataLens Africa as a Data Annotation Specialist! 🚀

Are you detail-oriented and eager to contribute to the future of Artificial Intelligence in Africa? At DataLens Africa, we connect talented individuals like you with opportunities to help train the next generation of AI systems. As a Data Annotation Specialist, your work will shape how AI understands and interacts with the world.

📌 About DataLens Africa
DataLens Africa is a trusted AI data company providing high-quality, locally relevant datasets for machine learning, computer vision, and NLP applications.
Our mission is to build Africa’s most reliable data ecosystem — empowering innovation and fair representation in AI through diverse and accurate data.

🎯 Your Role as a Data Annotation Specialist
As part of our contributor network, you will:

  • Label and categorize text, images, videos, or audio datasets for AI model training.

  • Follow task-specific guidelines to ensure accuracy and consistency.

  • Collaborate with QA teams to refine annotation quality.

  • Participate in short projects that directly impact AI systems across industries.

🛠 What We’re Looking For

  • Excellent attention to detail and focus.

  • Comfortable using digital tools and web-based platforms
